Class EfsEventBus.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.efs.bus.EfsEventBus.Builder
Enclosing class:
EfsEventBus
public static final class EfsEventBus.Builder extends Object
Configures and creates a new event bus instance. The builder allows callers to provide a custom clock and optional event-exhaust callbacks before constructing the bus. Each bus name must be unique within the JVM; creating a second bus with the same name results in an IllegalStateException.

Charles W. Rapp

    • eventExhaust

      public EfsEventBus.Builder eventExhaust(Consumer<EfsEnvelope> exhaustCB, IEfsAgent exhaustAgent)
      Sets efs event exhaust callback and agent to given values. This pair is used to exhaust newly published events to persistent store.
      Parameters:
      exhaustCB - method used to persist given row.
      exhaustAgent - agent performing event row persistence.
      Returns:
      this Builder instance.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if either exhaustCB or exhaustAgent is null.
